steps.note: Open the prepared closed RFQ in Master QCS.
Enter the awarding screen where proposal value and line-item selection are shown.
Verify the proposal value is zero before any line item is selected.
Capture the vendor’s displayed Sum Total for comparison after selection.
Select the line item for awarding to the available vendor.
Verify Tot. Proposal Value equals the vendor’s Sum Total after selection.
